04Seasonal Tip · Detail
09:41● ● ▮
Seasonal Tip
Published Apr 22

Prune your Robusta before the rains

—
—·Senior Agronomist·— min read

The short rains are a fortnight away in Mpigi, Butambala and Gomba. Pruning your Robusta trees now opens the canopy so next month's blossoms set into bigger, cleaner cherries.

What to cut: low branches touching the ground, suckers growing from the stump, and cross-branches shading the middle of the tree.

What to leave: healthy bearing branches from last season and new shoots angled upward.

Collect all cuttings and burn them away from the field — this stops coffee leaf rust overwintering on shed leaves.

☕ Robusta coffee MpigiButambala

    POPULAR QUESTIONS
    My payment was successful but my order shows "Awaiting payment" — what do I do?
    Admin verification usually takes 10–30 minutes. If your order still shows "Awaiting payment" after 30 minutes, re-upload your MTN/Airtel SMS confirmation from My Orders, or contact the outlet directly.
    How do I trace my coffee batch?
    Open the Trace tool and enter the Batch ID printed on your receipt or sack tag. You'll see the full journey — farm, pack-house, warehouse and export.
    What's the difference between mobile money and cash on collection?
    Mobile money lets you pay instantly with MTN or Airtel and we reserve your items right away. Cash on collection means you pay at the outlet when you pick up — stock isn't held until you arrive.
    Can I change my phone number?
    Your phone number is also your login, so it can't be changed in the app. Contact us on WhatsApp or by phone and we'll update it for you after verifying your identity.
    How do I become an Agent?
    Tap your role on the Welcome screen or contact us to apply as an Agent. After you submit your details, your outlet manager reviews the application — approval usually takes 24–48 hours.

    • Check your SMS inbox — it can be filtered by your carrier.
